label: prf:main-commutative-diagram
title: Proof of Main Commutative Diagram
html:
We verify commutativity by tracing both paths around the diagram.

Top-right path (variational \to coupling). This path turns a jet into a substrate parameter q and its Hamiltonian \hat{H}_q. Applying the Euler--Lagrange operator \mathfrak{E}[\mathfrak{S}_q] to a jet j^1_p \sigma yields the variational equation \mathrm{Ric}_{g_\varTheta} = T^{(q)} (GR substrate geometry). Solving for L_\varTheta determines the Webster metric. This in turn fixes the substrate field via the coupling q(p) = 1 + \lvert\langle L_\varTheta, F_A^+\rangle\rvert. This determines \hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1}, the q-Reeb field \xi_q, and the q-Hamiltonian \hat{H}_q = -\tfrac{1}{2}\hbar_q\Delta_q + V_q appearing in the transport equation.

Left-bottom path (evaluation \to transport). This path turns the same jet into a transported wavefunction \psi. The jet evaluation map j^1_p \sigma \mapsto \sigma(p) produces a section \psi \in \Gamma(\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{lin}}) by linearising the fibre \mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}) at the chosen base-point. Parallel transport along A then imposes J\hbar_q\iota_{\xi_q} D_A\psi = \hat{H}_q\psi (Schrödinger equation).

Commutativity. Both paths share the same input (j^1_p \sigma) and output (a section \psi satisfying the transport equation at substrate parameter q). The chain rule for the composite \mathfrak{S}_q[\nabla, L_\varTheta, \psi] factorises the variation into two coupled equations:

  1. \delta \mathfrak{S}_q / \delta L_\varTheta = 0 determines L_\varTheta (hence q and \hat{H}_q) along the top row.
  2. \delta \mathfrak{S}_q / \delta \psi = 0 yields D_\nabla\psi = 0 (variational equations, Item 3) along the bottom row.

The coupling q = 1 + \lvert\langle L_\varTheta, F_A^+\rangle\rvert ensures that the parameter q matches along both paths. The non-degeneracy of \int_A (Frobenius pairing) guarantees the solution sets agree. Solving for L_\varTheta first and substituting into the transport equation yields the same \psi as evaluating the jet and transporting along A.
